items.title: A_lens external prior from LSST kappa-kappa to push LiteBIRD** (W4 CF-W4.6)
items.what: Tighten W4-37 joint sigma(n_T) using LSST kappa-kappa prior on A_lens. Test whether sigma drops below 0.04 PASS threshold under the prior.
items.inputs: W4-37 Fisher construction; LSST kappa-kappa forecast (Eifler et al.).

items.title: f_B = c_S_canon coincidence test
items.what: Test whether W5-64 INFO observation f_B_joint = 0.485 = c_S_canon is a closed-form identity or a 6-sig-fig coincidence; decompose f_B inversion chain to determine whether c_S_canon appears by construction or by physical input.
items.inputs: W5-64 data; S83 G46 r_CMB derivation; sound-speed definitions at fold.

items.title: f_B = c_S_canon identity test** (W5 D.5)
items.what: Test whether f_B_joint = 0.485 = c_S_canon is closed-form identity or 6-sig-fig coincidence. Decompose f_B inversion chain.
items.inputs: W5-64 data; S83 G46 r_CMB derivation; sound-speed definitions at fold.

items.title: LiteBIRD n_T W4-41 permanent registry landing**: write up EVOI=0 as structural
items.what: **LiteBIRD n_T W4-41 permanent registry landing**: write up EVOI=0 as structurally permanent for 2030-2040 window; attach to W4-48 rigor registry as reference for DET-STERILE scope
items.inputs: W4-41 verdict, W4-37 3-param Fisher numerics, rescue-path enumeration (6-yr LB, LSST κκ, delensing >50%)

items.title: n_T(CMB) two-speed re-adjudication under W4-48** (from W4 CF-W4.4): test wheth
items.what: **n_T(CMB) two-speed re-adjudication under W4-48** (from W4 CF-W4.4): test whether S68's c_T=c_S=1 assumption was a CHOICE or a CONSEQUENCE of prior convention
items.inputs: W4-48 flag entry row 4, W4-39 derivation chain, S68 LITEB-R-FORECAST-68 code

items.title: S85-LITEBIRD-N_T-RESCUE-PATHS
items.what: Test whether external A_lens prior (LSST κκ) tightens W4-37 σ(n_T)_joint below 0.04 PASS. Also test extended 6-7 yr LB mission and >50% delensing as alternative paths.
items.inputs: W4-37 Fisher construction; LSST κκ forecast; 7-yr LB extended mission specs.

items.title: Two-speed acoustic metric prediction-detector mapping
items.what: Verify that c_T/c_S = 2.062 from a_2/a_0 spectral moments is structurally preserved at L_max ≥ 8 (post V.1); compute n_T(k_CMB) under the L_max=8 spectrum; project R_realized for delensing > 50% and external A_lens prior from LSST κκ to test whether any 2030-2040 detector combination crosses the 1σ
items.inputs: W4-39 derivation chain; W4-37 Fisher 3-param construction; LSST κκ forecast; W2-15 a_0 + a_2 L1-admissibility result.
